scope.applies_to: R0-C deployed Release BOM issuance and verification for the candidate validator and active release binding authority

explicit_non_scope.statement: This RSA-PSS profile is cryptographically disjoint from the dormant F6-F9 ECDSA Release BOM protocol; neither contract accepts the other's identifier or signing domain.

private_key_boundary.repository_material: public verification facts and conformance vectors only

key_profile.identity_and_material_binding: one exact key_id, identity, modulus_hex, exponent tuple
key_profile.modulus_encoding: canonical lowercase unsigned hexadecimal without a leading zero nibble

signing_input.payload_definition: for each issued lifecycle wire, all top-level Release BOM members except the single signature member
signing_input.payload_json_profile: sorted compact canonical JSON bound by the referenced number and string corpora

candidate_wire.role: candidate validation and active binding activation

stable_twin_wire.role: durable previous-stable lifecycle wire for a later non-bootstrap activation

lifecycle_pair.all_other_top_level_members: deep-equal JSON values; because both complete wires are canonical, each corresponding member has one byte-identical canonical encoding
lifecycle_pair.signature_rule: SIGNED and STABLE payloads are independently RSA-PSS signed; a signature from one status cannot be copied to the other
lifecycle_pair.issuance_rule: each accepted issuance creates and persists the exact SIGNED candidate wire and its exact STABLE lifecycle twin

next_candidate_reference.previous_stable_bom: bom_id of the exact persisted STABLE lifecycle twin
next_candidate_reference.previous_stable_bom_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 digest of the exact persisted STABLE lifecycle-twin wire

canonical_wire.ascii_escaping: disabled except JSON-required escapes and U+0000 through U+001F
canonical_wire.signature_value_encoding: RFC 4648 standard alphabet canonical padded Base64 with no whitespace

issuance_output.construction: independently insert each exact signature object and canonicalize the complete SIGNED and STABLE Release BOM wires
persist_before_return: exact canonical SIGNED final wire bytes
exact canonical STABLE lifecycle-twin final wire bytes
lowercase SHA-256 digest of each exact final wire
selected key identity and material binding
issuance_output.identical_request_behavior: return both byte-identical persisted final wires; do not perform either randomized RSA-PSS issuance again
issuance_output.release_bom_sha256_definition: lowercase SHA-256 digest of the applicable exact persisted SIGNED or STABLE final wire bytes
issuance_output.consumer_rule: candidate, activation, previous-stable binding, recovery, receipt, and retry paths reuse the applicable exact persisted final wire bytes
